mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5% but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in UNRATE and PAYEMS suggest a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase but SPX returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO indicates increased production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% but SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 coupled with a decrease in INDPRO suggests demand-supply imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls but SPX returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST indicates strong housing market, signaling economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
